description: The LineDot chart is an animated line chart with fun animated dots. Use the LineDot chart to engage your audience when presenting data. The size of the bubbles can be customized based on data. Use the counter to show a running total as the chart animates. Format options are provided for Lines, Dots, and Animation. This is an open source visual. Get the code from GitHub: https://github.com/Microsoft/powerbi-visuals-linedotchart
